name: Stardust G
summary: Stardust G is a phone-farm client who first contacted the owner on WhatsApp and is now texting from a new number. They rent farm phones and remote PCs to run warmed-up model accounts (Reels posting, warm-up, trials). The owner moved them to a new farm, but none of their phones from the old farm (Red, Purple, Green, Yellow and Blue sets) showed up in the new admin panel, and the setup was slow because it was still on Wi-Fi. The owner promised to fix it that night, and a network splitter for a direct internet connection was due the next day. Follow up to confirm all their phones are back online and the accounts didn't get paused.
key_facts: Calls themselves 'Stardust G'; first contact was on WhatsApp, then texted from a new phone number
Uses the ALTR phone farm through the remote admin panel at altr.fmaremote.com
Phone groups: Red #2 and #D1–D10, Purple #D1–D10, Green #D1–D3, Yellow #D1–D4, Blue #D1–D5
Each phone is assigned to a model account (e.g. Ambzy, Jane, Liza, Aly (Mya), Lauren Blake, Amber, Essence) with statuses like Reels, warmed up, Flagged, Trial, Banned, Cancelled
Shared a Google Sheet tracking phones, models and account status
After the move to the new farm, none of their old-farm phones were showing and one PC was offline
New farm was on Wi-Fi and slow; the splitter for a direct connection was arriving the next day
Owner promised to fix the phones the night of 2026-10-03; client said the accounts were 'crushing' and didn't want them paused
Updates are done over Google Meet calls
services_discussed: Remote PC/phone access via admin panel
Account warm-up and Reels posting for model accounts
Farm migration to a new location
